name: Demonheart: The Ice Demon
source:
In this otome visual novel, you play as the young witch Shar, who was invited to live with a famous older witch. Shar's host needs protection from the demonic prisoners she keeps beneath her house. As Shar learns more of the house's secrets, she can build a relationship with her host's brother... or one of her prisoners.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711620/Demonheart_The_Ice_Demon/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部乙女视觉小说中，你将扮演年轻女巫莎尔。她受一位年长的知名女巫邀请，搬进了对方家中。女主人将恶魔囚禁在屋子地下，需要莎尔保护自己。随着莎尔逐渐了解这栋房子的秘密，她可以与女主人的兄弟……或其中一名囚徒发展感情。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711620/Demonheart_The_Ice_Demon/]Steam[/url]]
